contexts: Enterprise home, Identity sources: NIN/BVN capability card.
National identity and bank-verification source records used for requested identity checks.
entries.reason: The subject is specifically Nigeria's NIN and BVN records. Reusable stock results showed office paperwork, door-access fingerprint readers, phone unlocking, or foreign registration programs; those do not identify the requested sources. Use an original source-record illustration with two clearly labeled records and masked 11-digit fields. NIMC defines NIN as an 11-digit identifier tied to demographic and biometric enrollment data; NIBSS defines BVN as an 11-digit identifier across Nigerian bank accounts. The drawing is an explanatory record view, not a government-issued card, enrollment screen, actual personal record, or claim of agency endorsement.
entries.creator: Ontiver original diagram
entries.alt: Illustration of separate NIN and BVN source records with masked 11-digit identifiers

contexts: Enterprise home, Identity sources: Employers and referees capability card.
Employment records that an employer or referee can use when confirming requested claims.
entries.reason: The document explicitly concerns an employment relationship and includes employee and employer-authorized-representative signature fields. This identifies a concrete employment source record instead of depicting a candidate interview or generic meeting. Standard 16:9 and 4:3 crops retain the contract heading and signature area; the last card's unusually wide desktop crop uses a 25% vertical focal point to preserve the complete CONTRACT heading and employment wording. It is a photographed sample employment document, not an actual completed reference, a Nigerian legal template, or proof that Ontiver verifies the photographed record.
